sources.en_wiki: Black Clover Wiki (blackclover.fandom.com) pages and spell lists, read through WebSearch summaries only: the wiki host is not reachable from the build machine (the search summaries name the pages and quote their descriptions).
sources.ja_search: Japanese pages found by WebSearch (ja.wikipedia.org Black Clover article, manga-tantei.com character articles, pixiv encyclopedia, ja.namu.wiki spell list, bclover.jp character files): Japanese spell names and one-line effects, read through search summaries only.
sources.design: Order of acquisition decided by this mod from the arcs (the exact chapter or episode of most spells was not confirmed): see docs/magic/character_spells_gold.md.

spells.name: Moonlight Magic: Crescent Cut
spells.note: Offensive, mid range: crescent-shaped moonlight blades, several at once. NEW page (drawn in the Light book: Moonlight has no book of its own).

spells.name: Moonlight Magic: Bewitching Moonlight
spells.note: Supplementary: tries to take control of a target's body by suppressing its mana and will; several people at once. NEW page; the mod holds the targets instead of controlling them.

spells.name: Moonlight Magic: Full Moon Shell
spells.note: Close-range defence: a dark sphere round the user that knocks back attacks and attackers. NEW page.

spells.name: Moonlight Magic: Crescent Cut Full Moon
spells.note: She creates a Full Moon Shell and erratically fires several Crescent Cuts from it. NEW page.

spells.name: Moonlight Magic: Lunatic Crisis
spells.note: Long range: she gathers mana round the red moon and releases it as an enormous ray of moonlight. NEW page; the latest in the set.

spells.name: Light Magic: (travelling on a beam of light)
spells.note: The old shared page (travelling on a beam of light); moonlight is light, so it sits in her grimoire too.

notes: Moonlight Magic is not a magic of this mod (CanonBook gives her LIGHT), so her pages are appended to the Light book. Mode 0 of the Light book (Light Sword of Judgment) cannot be hidden and stays in her grimoire. The owner may later give Moonlight its own MagicType and book; her set would then move with it.
